data.narrative:
Valstad is a Seed-stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Dustin Walper. The analysis draws on a comparison universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses Valstad's $2.6M total raised as a proxy for $3M current value, applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x, implying $6M. Peer-Median analysis examines four same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables: Stark Defence at $4.0B (Series A), UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). The median valuation across this set is $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range: $6M (low), $353M (median), and $805M (high). The disparity reflects meaningful uncertainty in the peer set's applicability. Stage-Progression yields a lower bound anchored to actual capital deployed; Peer-Median captures sector-level valuation density but includes substantial variance across adjacent stages and business models. Key uncertainties include stage alignment within the peer set and whether Defense & Security valuations are inflated by market sentiment or justified by defensibility. The median of $353M should be treated as an upper-middle estimate pending deeper operational due diligence.
